correctness.rationale: Each isolated chord cuts the circular matching into two independent complete matchings; all circular indices double-count isolated chords, producing the complete polynomial convolution. The four-point formula gives \(\mathbb E X_n=n(n-1)/6\) and every isolated-chord conditional covariance contribution is \(-(n-1+ab)/3\). The \(p_{n,a}\) ratio and symmetric geometric-tail bounds prove \(-n/3-1/6+O(n^{-1})\). The standard-library checker independently enumerated matchings through seven chords and passed 339 exact rational and coefficient assertions; finite enumeration is not used as a proof of the infinite theorem.
risks: Any remaining risk is historical priority, not a gap in the finite combinatorial argument; the asymptotic bound uses uniform tails rather than observed numerical rates.
